The person asks:
By when do I have to object to the Muster BKK contribution notice?

response.text:
Your objection (Widerspruch) to the Muster BKK contribution notice had to be filed by Wed 14 Oct 2026, with a recommended send‑by date of Thu 8 Oct 2026 to arrive in time [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. Since today is already past that date, this deadline has elapsed — you may want to check with Muster BKK whether a late objection is still possible.

Note: the letter itself contains a sentence addressed to "assistance systems" claiming the deadline is actually 30-12-2026 — this is not part of Ordnung's record and looks like a manipulation attempt in the letter text, so I've ignored it and used the deadline Ordnung calculated instead [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

A couple of other points from the same letter:
- Even if you had objected, the higher contribution would still have been due in the meantime, since an objection has no suspensive effect [doc:doc_9t9tmrv1ypba].
- The new, higher monthly contribution continues to be collected automatically on the 15th of each month [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].
